name: Alchemy FM Bridge
author: MMagTech
description: Push live radio stations from AudioMuse programming (Song Alchemy anchors or similar seeds) to any Alchemy FM instance via its admin API.

versions.changelog: Fix plugin load error: ship single-file zip (AudioMuse could not import alchemy_client module).
Initial release: configure Alchemy FM URL and admin credentials, design stations from anchors or seed tracks, and idempotently create/update/bootstrap stations.
